entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return. Order number is VF-92110.
Certainly, let me pull that up for you. VF-92110... Okay, I see it here. This is for the VeloFit Pro-Lite cycling shoes, delivered about two months ago. Is that correct?
Yes, that's them. I just want to know if I can return them for a refund. Yes or no.
I can definitely check on that for you. So I can note it down, could you tell me what the issue was with the shoes? Was it a technical fault or a preference issue?
They gave me blisters. I tried a few different rides, but they're just not working for me. So, can I get a refund or not?

I'm very sorry to hear about the blisters. Thank you for that information. Let me check the return eligibility... Yes, absolutely. You are unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. I can process this for you right now.
Okay, good. What do I do next?

I'm sending the return instructions to your email now. Please just ensure you've removed any cleats you might have attached. Once we receive the cycling shoes back at our warehouse, we'll issue the full refund to your original payment method.
Fine. Is there a shipping fee?
Normally there's a small deduction, but I see you're a VIP member with us, so I've gone ahead and waived that. The return shipping label I just sent is completely free of charge.
Great. That's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
